title: pinus contorta var. bolanderi
intro: Pinus contorta var. bolanderi, commonly known as Lodgepole Pine, is a variety of coniferous tree native to the mountainous regions of the western United States. This plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, including providing relief from respiratory issues, such as bronchitis and coughs, due to its anti-inflammatory and expectorant properties. The therapeutic actions of Pinus contorta var. bolanderi include bronchodilation, antiseptic, and antimicrobial effects, making it useful in treating various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include terpenoids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal and therapeutic properties.
